name: heritage-housing-projects
description: Heritage Housing Projects (Pvt) Ltd — corporate website and secure client portal.

comments.database: The data layer is asynchronous and runs on one of two engines, chosen at start-up by server/driver.js. With TURSO_DATABASE_URL set it uses the remote Turso database through @libsql/client; with it unset it falls back to the local node:sqlite file so development and the test suite need no network. Every caller awaits the same methods either way.
comments.install: @libsql/client is only required for the Turso path. Without TURSO_DATABASE_URL the server starts and the whole 214-check suite passes with no install step at all; the driver throws a clear error rather than silently writing to a local file if Turso is configured but the package is missing.
comments.node-version: node:sqlite requires Node 22.5 or newer. Developed and tested on Node 24.
